sentences.text:
Code Read With Sections 3/ 4 Of The D.P. ... vs In Re : Manoj
Kumar Saha on 13 February, 2024

Author: Debangsu Basak
Bench: Debangsu Basak
13.02.2024 S.D. Rejected C.R.M.(A) 454 of 2024 In Re:- In Re:- An application for anticipatory
bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Kusumandi Police
Station Case No. 219 of 2023 dated 02.09.2023 under Section 498A/307/34 of the Indian Penal
Code read with Sections 3/ 4 of the D.P. Act.
And In Re : Manoj Kumar Saha ...... petitioner Mr. Tapan Dutta Gupta Mr. P. anam Ms. R. Ghosh
Mr. S. Sardar ...for the petitioner Mr. Angshuman Chakraborty ...for the State Petitioner before us is
the husband.
Apparently, the petitioner stands implicated in an incident of assault against the defacto-complainant.
Moreover, materials in the case diary suggest that the petitioner demanded dowry and was mentally and physically tortured by the defacto-complainant.
In such circumstances, we are unable to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner and the prayer for anticipatory bail is rejected.
The application being CRM (A) 454 of 2024 is dismissed.

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
